issued_for: CORE_V1 long-run operation of subject alice-longrun
root_cause: The long-run checkpoint compared a committed belief transition's evidence refs against the bounded livedMemory(100) product read-model window instead of the durable-membership authority. Once the subject passed 100 episodes the oldest lawful episode necessarily left that window, so the checker raised CORE_INTEGRITY / BLOCKER for a perfectly lawful citation.
why_it_is_a_false_positive: the bounded read model is a display window (newest 100 entries), never a membership authority
the cited episode is a lawful durable member at its transition revision and at the head revision
no authority, checksum, revision or canonical ref was inconsistent; only the monitoring predicate was wrong

measured_controls.measured_by: read-only restore of alice-longrun and the production predicate through the product runtime (0 model calls)

correction.new_membership_source: production validateRefsBelong on the bound repository revision, exposed read-only through the product runtime (refsBelongToRevision)
semantics: every committed transition's evidence refs must belong at the HEAD revision (a truly dangling ref still BLOCKs)
they must also belong at the revision where monitoring first observed the transition (historical lawfulness is never replaced by head visibility)
no fallback, no second visibility law, no window, no manifest shortcut: without the production predicate the checker refuses to run

note: The checkpoint-100 artifact that recorded LR-002/LR-003 as BLOCKER is historical fact and is not modified; this record is the correction of record.
